notablePrerequisites: The combined mana value of cards in you library is greater than or equal to the sum of your opponents' life totals.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer's ability repeatedly to exile your entire library, adding a number of counter to it equal to the mana value of the exiled cards.
Use Deathbringer Thoctar's ability to remove +1/+1 counters to deal 1 damage to any target until your opponent are dead.
